weakest_scene.visible_evidence: In seg3:start the header reads 'HIGH-INCOME COUNTRIES IS 54% OF THE WHOLE'. A 100-cell waffle splits 54/37/9 as if these were parts of one whole, but they are separate treatment rates. The right-hand legend labels are cut off at the frame edge, Data stands over the grid, and the waffle shows 54% while the narration says 53%.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The relationship classifier picked 'share' (parts of one whole) for a set of independent treatment-coverage rates per income group. The waffle composer then laid the legend out by character count, not measured width, so it overflows the 430px frame.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show each income group as its own vessel or population: for example, three rows of 10 patients where Data hands medicine to 5.3, 3.7 and 0.9 of each 10, with the untreated patients left grey. Use no part-of-whole framing. Measure the labels so they fit inside the frame, match the narration's 53%, and keep Data out of the cells he is not acting on.
